definition: 用户在过去30天内成功登录平台的次数
sql_logic: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as login_count FROM login_log WHERE login_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY user_id

definition: 用户历史累计消费总金额（人民币）
sql_logic: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) as total_spent FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY user_id

definition: 用户最近一次成功登录的时间戳
sql_logic: SELECT user_id, MAX(login_time) as last_login_time FROM login_log GROUP BY user_id

definition: 用户注册时来源渠道，如：应用商店、广告投放、自然流量等
sql_logic: SELECT user_id, channel as register_channel FROM users

definition: 用户在过去30天内有多少天有登录行为
sql_logic: SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(login_time)) as active_days FROM login_log WHERE login_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY user_id
